column1: # Design parameters that README.md, docs/REPORT.md, and docs/cards/*.md may show without a
# claim marker (tools/claimcheck.py): thresholds, caps, sample-size targets, confidence
# levels. Never a measured result. Columns are separated by one tab: the number exactly as
# written, a Python regex whose match on the same line must contain the number and reach
# beyond it (for example 95% CI), and the reason. An entry without a reason fails

column3: confidence level of every interval (95% intervals, docs/BUILD_BRIEF.md section 6); a design parameter, not a result

the preregistered G5 threshold for recall and precision (prereg/0001, docs/BUILD_BRIEF.md section 6), a design parameter, not a result; allowed only inside a threshold phrase (0.90 threshold, 0.90 targets, threshold 0.90, target at least 0.90, thresholds of at least 0.90), never bare after a comparison word such as below and never right after a plural such as targets (review N4); the row cannot tell whether a comparison with the threshold is true (below the 0.90 threshold passes whatever the result), so each sentence that states one shows the compared results as claims and is listed with what it asserts in tests/test_e0_tables.py, which checks it against the artifact and fails on a 0.90 in any sentence it does not list
